newsitem.title: USA: 1st Source raises $42.5 mln via preferred.
newsitem.headline: 1st Source raises $42.5 mln via preferred.

text.p: 1st Source Corp, a bank holding company, said Friday it raised an aggregate of $42.5 million from offerings of cumulative trust preferred securities.
Proceeds from the offering will be used for general corporate purposes.

It said $27.5 million was raised through issuance by 1st Source Capital Trust I, a Delaware business trust subsidiary, of nine percent cumulative trust preferred securities. The fixed-rate cumulative trust preferred securities were issued at $25 per share.
1st Source said $15 million was raised through issuance by 1st Source Capital Trust II of floating rate cumulative trust preferred securities. The securities were issued at $25 per share.
Stifel, Nicolaus & Co Inc was managing underwriter for the offerings.
